summary: Created FastAPI sample app files, ingestion and query scripts, README and assets. Attempted to install Python dependencies but pip install failed due to building pydantic-core on Python 3.13 (no prebuilt wheel). Because of that, I switched to using the DocumentDB MCP data-plane tools for verification. Attempts to call MCP create-index/insert APIs failed (function returned error). Verification via MCP could not be completed due to function errors. The repository is ready for a user to install dependencies locally (preferably on Python 3.11/3.12) and run the ingestion and app against a reachable DocumentDB cluster.
how_to_run:
1) Copy .env.example to .env and set DOCUMENTDB_URI and optionally OPENAI_API_KEY.
2) python -m pip install -r requirements.txt (recommended Python 3.11 or 3.12 to avoid pydantic-core build issues).
3) Ingest data: python scripts/ingest.py --count 10000 (use --count 100 for quick verification).
4) Run server: uvicorn app.main:app --reload
5) Open http://localhost:8000 and use the UI to run substitute lookups.
